agents.name: Muse

access.free_tier: yes — free with a usage limit that refreshes (limit not stated officially)
access.billing_note: Renews monthly on the purchase anniversary until cancelled; cancel any time. Sign in with a Meta account
access.subscription_note: Subscriptions in limited testing; not available in all locations; 18+

agents.actions: browse web, fill forms, send email, book travel, purchases, negotiate on user's behalf
agents.execution: Muse Secure VM — dedicated cloud VM holding agent + user data; Sentinel agent must approve anything that reaches the internet
agents.safety: Checks with the person before sensitive actions like sending an email or making a purchase; approval modes: Ask for some actions (every write and important read) or Always ask

privacy.training: Users can opt out of interactions being used to train Meta's models
privacy.confidential_compute: Muse Confidential VM, user-held key — announced for later in 2026 (not live)
privacy.delete_data: Delete single messages, side chats and files; Reset Muse permanently deletes everything, including chat history; deleting the Meta account deletes Muse data

agents.name: dots

access.required_plan_for_agent: ChatGPT Pro or Business Premium (Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare: beta, admin-enabled)

paid_plans.name: Pro 200
paid_plans.note: open to new sign-ups again; new subscriptions get a lower usage allowance

access.included: First dot included at no extra cost; plan includes an allowance for deeper work (extended limits first month). Extra dots: 'in the future', price not announced
access.billing_note: Pro is monthly only; no annual billing. Pro 200 is open to new subscriptions again, with a lower usage allowance for new subscribers; grandfathered Pro 200 subscribers keep their previous allowance through 2026-10-29

platforms.mobile_app: chat after setup; cannot create a dot on mobile

agents.actions: own cloud computer + browser; connected apps; scheduled/recurring tasks; proactive background research (read-only tools); optional access to user's laptop
agents.execution: Own cloud computer; user can open it to inspect work
agents.safety: Auto-review of account-affecting actions; Custom Rules (act / act if pre-approved / ask / hand off); sensitive tasks like password change always stay with user; monitoring can pause the dot

privacy.training: Personal plans: user controls whether dot conversations/work improve models. Business/Enterprise/Edu not used by default. No direct training on proactive research or dot's notes
privacy.delete_data: Reset deletes dot, conversations, memories, scheduled tasks; disconnecting an app does not delete data already obtained

agents.name: Grok Bot
agents.vendor: SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) — also distributed via Cursor

access.required_plan_for_agent: SuperGrok / SuperGrok Plus / SuperGrok Heavy / X Premium+ (linked), Cursor Pro / Pro+ / Ultra, Cursor Teams; Enterprise
access.usage_note: Grok Bot has its own usage, separate from Grok/Cursor plans; resets weekly; overage via Cursor on-demand usage

agents.actions: multi-step work across apps and websites; computer control; connectors; learns workflows from demonstration; bots coordinate with each other
agents.execution: Persistent cloud computer per bot (browser, filesystem, terminal) on Cursor's cloud; optional execution on your own computer (ask each time / always / never)
agents.safety: Asks for approval before sending messages, publishing, purchases and transfers, deleting data, changing permissions, production changes, accepting legal terms; Auto Review rules (ask-first wins)

privacy.training: Follows your Cursor account privacy settings; Legacy Privacy Mode not supported
privacy.delete_data: Deleting a bot doesn't remove files or sessions on its shared computer; retention follows Cursor terms

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.vendor: OpenClaw Foundation (501(c)(3)); created by Peter Steinberger

access.free_tier: yes — free, open-source software with no paid tier, hosted service or token; you pay for your own hosting and model API or subscription

agents.actions: personal assistant you message from chat apps: inbox, email, calendar and flight check-ins; runs tools, skills and plugins on the machine it is installed on; scheduled jobs and reminders
agents.execution: Runs on your own computer or server through a local Gateway. Desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux install everything; or use the installer, npm (Node.js 24.16+ or 26.1+), Docker or Nix. Tools run on the host for the main session unless you configure sandboxing
agents.safety: DM channels need a pairing approval; docs say treat inbound messages as untrusted input and read the security guide before exposing it remotely

privacy.training: Depends on the model provider and chat platforms you connect; OpenClaw has no hosted service. By default it sends only a daily version check; anonymous feature statistics are opt-in and both can be turned off

agents.name: Lindy
agents.category: work agent (AI teammate in Slack, inbox and meetings)

access.free_tier: trial — $50 in free credits for 7 days, no credit card required
access.usage_note: Credits refresh each billing cycle and do not roll over; every seat adds its credits to one shared workspace pool. When credits run out, Lindy pauses credit-using actions until the next cycle
access.billing_note: One workspace subscription billed per seat; removed seats stay active through the paid cycle, with no mid-cycle proration

agents.actions: inbox management and replies drafted in your voice; meeting recording, notes, scheduling, prep and follow-up; daily briefs and scheduled routines; research, data analysis, decks and dashboards; 40+ skills plus your own; computer use on Pro and Max
agents.execution: Hosted service; works in Slack threads and mentions, iMessage and the web app; Chrome extension available
agents.safety: Anything with outside impact (sending an email, updating a ticket, posting to another channel, publishing a doc) waits for approval; read-only lookups from approved sources do not. Every action is logged. Enterprise adds SSO and audit logs

privacy.training: Lindy says your data is encrypted, never sold and never used to train models, by Lindy or its providers. SOC 2 Type II; HIPAA with a signed BAA on Enterprise
privacy.delete_data: Request deletion by email; account termination deletes data from active databases, with some retention for fraud prevention and legal requirements

agents.model: Model selection on every plan; most major models available

agents.name: Gemini Spark

access.required_plan_for_agent: Google AI Pro or Ultra, 18+, signed in with a personal Google Account (Google also lists select business users); the Mac app beta needs Google AI Ultra

agents.regions: Wherever the Gemini app is supported, except the European Economic Area, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Nigeria
agents.actions: multi-step tasks across Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets and other Google apps; runs in the background 24/7; can run tasks on your Mac
agents.execution: Google's cloud; keeps working when your laptop is closed or your phone is locked
agents.safety: Designed to ask you first before high-stakes actions like spending money or sending emails; app connections are off by default. Asks before each task that browses the web, you can take over or stop its browser at any time, and schedules can be paused. Google warns a schedule that runs while you are offline may complete an unintended action

privacy.delete_data: Delete saved remote-browser data (including sign-in cookies) and remote code-execution data in Spark settings; turning Spark off deletes both. Chats are managed in Gemini Apps Activity

agents.name: Instinct

access.billing_note: Terms say some features may require fees, charged in U.S. dollars; no prices published. New users join a waitlist and get a text when their spot opens

agents.actions: uses a phone and computer the way a person does: disputing bills, sending gifts, ordering groceries, scheduling doctor's appointments, planning trips; can make purchases on connected services with the payment method you provide
agents.safety: Terms say Instinct may add confirmation requirements or other controls on certain actions but does not promise they prevent mistakes; actions may not be reversible and you remain responsible for them. Payment details and passwords you share let it act for you; a Vault feature keeps materials out of model training

privacy.training: Content and usage data may be used to train AI models unless you opt out at app.instinct.com/settings; safety-flagged material can still be used after opt-out. Vault materials and Google Workspace data are never used for training. Shared with third-party AI model providers
privacy.delete_data: Request deletion of indexed connected-service data at app.instinct.com/workspace (disconnecting alone does not delete it); deleting your account deletes collected Google Workspace data

agents.model: Third-party large language models; providers not named

agents.name: Poke

access.free_tier: yes — free forever, no credit card required; every plan gets all of Poke

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.usage: frontier models for complex tasks, real-time background automations, higher rate limits

paid_plans.name: Ultra
paid_plans.usage: frontier models for every action, highest rate limits, Poke Human
paid_plans.note: plus pay-as-you-go usage beyond your credits

agents.actions: email (Gmail, Outlook), calendars and contacts; reminders and scheduled tasks; proactive updates from connected apps; Recipes for integrations and automations (Notion, GitHub, Linear, Oura and more, or custom MCP); builds and publishes a personal site at yourname.poke.site; Ultra: Poke Human sends real-world tasks to a person
agents.safety: Poke Human operators see only the details a task needs, not your chat history, memories or integrations; real-world expenses are charged at cost from your credit balance

privacy.delete_data: Delete Account at poke.com/settings/privacy; deletion takes up to 24 hours, backups may take longer and legal holds can extend retention

agents.name: Hermes Agent

access.free_tier: yes — free, open-source software (MIT); model and hosting costs depend on what you connect
access.billing_note: Optional: Nous Portal plans with monthly model and tool credits (Plus $20, Super $100, Ultra $200 a month; free tier with free models only). Optional Hermes Cloud hosting is billed daily from Nous credit ($0.56 or $1.09 a day running, plus inference)

agents.actions: creates and improves reusable skills from experience; keeps persistent memory; natural-language scheduled automations; parallel subagents; web search, browser automation, vision, image generation and text-to-speech
agents.execution: Self-hosted on your computer, a VPS, a GPU cluster or serverless, with terminal backends including local, Docker, SSH, Singularity and Modal; desktop apps for macOS and Windows; or an always-on Hermes Cloud agent hosted by Nous
agents.safety: Dangerous shell commands need explicit approval (configurable modes, including auto-approve for cron and unattended runs); DM pairing and allowlists control who can talk to the agent; container isolation
agents.model: any — Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or a custom endpoint

privacy.training: Depends on the model provider you connect. Nous Portal's privacy policy lets you turn on Privacy Mode to opt out of storage and use of certain inference payloads for training

access.included: All features are offered in every plan; paid tiers increase usage
access.billing_note: Monthly paid subscriptions renew automatically; website cancellation at least 24 hours before period end. Optional auto top-up with a user-set amount and ceiling. App-store prices may differ
access.subscription_note: 18+, or the higher minimum age required locally

agents.actions: browser errands and purchases; calendar and email work; Projects with files; custom Panels; suggested Action Buttons; repeatable Specialties; scheduled and conditional tasks
agents.execution: Handoff runs on a cloud computer; Hark's launch article says up to six browsers at once
agents.safety: By default asks before spending money or sending communications, unless you grant standing permission; watch and cancel browser actions; scheduled tasks can be paused or cancelled

privacy.delete_data: Ask Hark to review, edit or delete memories. Delete Account in Settings → Profile; legal and security retention exceptions apply

agents.model: Handoff for computer use; full model lineup not stated

agents.name: Airtap

access.free_tier: yes — free during the current release, with a daily usage cap; cap size not published. Invite only
access.billing_note: Terms say paid subscription tiers are planned for a future release; no prices published

agents.actions: operates real mobile apps on a cloud Android phone: clips coupons and card offers, books classes and reservations, tracks prices, posts to social apps, orders rides and groceries; saved routines run on a schedule
agents.execution: A dedicated Android phone in the cloud, always on and signed in to your apps; optional AutoPilot app (Android, sideloaded) controls your own phone. A SKILLS.md file lets Claude, Codex or OpenClaw drive an Airtap phone
agents.safety: You sign in to your own apps; Airtap says it never sees or stores passwords, the agent is blocked from reading password and card fields, each phone runs in an isolated container and sessions are wiped on logout. Web app shows a live view and step history

privacy.training: Task text, conversation history and cloud-phone screenshots go to Google (Gemini), Anthropic, xAI, OpenAI, Groq and AssemblyAI, which the policy says do not train on it. Terms allow anonymized, aggregated usage data for model improvement
privacy.delete_data: Data processed on your device is kept up to 30 days unless a routine stores results; usage logs up to 12 months; early deletion on request

agents.model: Third-party models from Google (Gemini), Anthropic, xAI, OpenAI, Groq and AssemblyAI; routing not stated

agents.name: Underdog

access.free_tier: yes — free, with no paid plan; Underdog says it will announce any charge before billing anyone. Invite only
access.subscription_note: 13+; a personal licence to run the app on your own computers

agents.actions: email triage and drafts, calendar, meeting recording and notes, system-wide dictation, chat; a browser agent runs errands in your own browser and prepares sensitive tasks (doctor's appointments, prescription refills, tax paperwork) for your approval
agents.execution: Runs on your computer: Underdog's own models (Woof 4B, Saluki 27B, Underdog 27B) handle summaries, drafts, chat and transcription locally; mail syncs directly between your computer and Google or Microsoft. Local MCP and a custom dictation server are optional
agents.safety: The browser agent asks before it buys, pays, sends or deletes anything and fills saved passwords without reading them. Mail, calendar and saved logins are encrypted on disk with a device-only key. Naval mode limits network traffic to the servers it needs. Passed an App Defense Alliance CASA Level 1 assessment (Leviathan Security Group, Sep 2026); Google approved its Gmail and Calendar access

privacy.training: Your content is processed on your device and not sent to any cloud AI service. Underdog's servers hold your account email, membership, an optional daily usage count (no content) and crash reports only if you send them
privacy.delete_data: Delete memories in Settings; delete your Underdog account from the account page, which deletes the account data it holds. Content on your computer is removed with the app

agents.model: Underdog's own on-device models: Woof 4B, Saluki 27B and Underdog 27B (built on Qwen 3.8 27B)
